proposition: Ibn Turka complains that the Hurufis were the very group that made preoccupation with the science of letters a crime and yet escaped the charge, while he, who had opposed them, saw his petition fail and his family's honour smeared.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, Nafsat al-Masdur II (ca. 832-35/1429-32, after exile)
mediation.note: written to the court that was judging him; MK: produced under duress, treat with caution (pdf p.32 fn 44)
